title: Membership
content:
# Membership

Club membership is managed by [RiderHQ](https://www.riderhq.com/groups/chippenham-wheelers/join), with payments taken online. Membership queries can be sent to [secretary@chippenhamwheelers.org](mailto:secretary@chippenhamwheelers.org).

## Chippenham Sports and Social Club

The club is affiliated with the [Chippenham Sports and Social Club](http://www.chippenhamsportsclub.co.uk/) and club membership includes CSSC membership. Benefits include access to the bar, toilets and showers, parking, food and drink, and club facilities for events.

## Membership Year

The membership year follows the CSSC year and runs to 1 April. The current membership price and renewal terms are maintained by RiderHQ.

## Join or Renew

Visit RiderHQ to view the current membership categories, prices and terms.

[Apply for membership](https://www.riderhq.com/groups/chippenham-wheelers/join)

Membership administration, accounts and payment processing remain with RiderHQ and are not handled by this site.
